sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fmap over Nothing — applying a transformation to an absent value silently propagates Nothing without ever executing the function.
sketches.resonance: You can offer everything you have to give, but if the other person was never there, none of it reaches anyone.
sketches.draft:
give :: a -> Maybe b -> Maybe a
give _ Nothing  = Nothing
give x (Just _) = Just x

main = print (give 42 Nothing)

sketches.mechanism: A variable that is moved (ownership transferred) can never be used again — the compiler enforces that the original binding is dead after the move.
sketches.resonance: Once you truly give yourself to someone, the version of you that existed before is gone; the compiler won't even let you pretend otherwise.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN where the right table has no matching rows produces NULL in every column of the absent side — the structure of presence reveals the shape of what's missing.
sketches.resonance: The query faithfully returns every row of you, but the columns where I should appear are all NULL — my absence has a schema.
